what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Sri Lanka in Italy: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7128 Sri Lankan asylum seekers in Italy, 21.2% of all asylum seekers from Sri Lanka.
Refugees from Sri Lanka, a separate group, live mostly in India, France, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Eelam territory in Sri Lanka with the LTTE from 2005 to 2009, at war level in most of those years.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2024 and 2025, come well after that conflict ended.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2010 at 27 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Italy only.
